name: Omnia
what: Agentic platform that helps marketing teams track and improve how AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) present their brand.
homonym_note: Many unrelated companies and venues are named Omnia (Google News hits include unrelated University of Pennsylvania items).

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); Visionaries Club led the Oct 2025 pre-seed (the firm's own announcement, relayed by capital-riesgo.es).
membership.quote: The round was led by Visionaries Club, with participation from KFund , Baobab Ventures

entry.quote: closed a €3.5 million pre-seed funding round. The round was led by Visionaries

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Omnia" Visionaries -> only the Oct 2025 pre-seed (capital-riesgo.es, eu-startups, TFN); no later round
notes: Founded 2025 ('Founded earlier this year', TFN 2025-10-16) by Daniel Espejo (ex-Klarna) and Miguel Fernández (ex-GitHub, Fastly). capital-riesgo.es carries the firm's own announcement ('Visionaries has announced that it has led a €3.5 million pre-seed', source: Visionaries' LinkedIn post). Focus: the product is an autonomous-agent platform, so AI & Applied AI; SaaS (marketing software) is the alternative if the judge reads it as an SEO tool. Entry is under a year old, so no graduation yet.
